findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich specification
findings.message: Kurztext and Langtext do not specify the Homogenbereich (e.g., B1) for the excavation, which is required for risk allocation under VOB/C § 4.2 and the geotechnical report.
findings.suggestion: Add Homogenbereich reference and depth limits, e.g., "Baugrube ausheben, Homogenbereich [B1] gemäß Geotechnischem Bericht vom [Datum], Aushubtiefe bis [3,00] m, Boden seitlich lagern."

findings.title: Missing insulation thickness and thermal conductivity
findings.message: The description of the Wärmedämmung Boden lacks the required thickness, material type, and thermal conductivity (Wärmeleitfähigkeit), which are mandatory for compliance with VOB/C and the GEG.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Wärmedämmplatten aus XPS, d = 100 mm, WLS 035, druckbelastbar [CS(10/Y) 300], Stöße versetzt."

findings.title: Missing water exposure class for waterproofing
findings.message: The Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile position does not state the Wassereinwirkungsklasse, which is required for the selection of the appropriate waterproofing material and for GEG compliance.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile mit PMBC, Wassereinwirkungsklasse [W1.2-E] nach DIN 18533, Trockenschichtdicke mind. 3 mm, einschließlich Hohlkehle."

findings.title: Unspecified site preparation scope
findings.message: The Kurztext "Baustelleneinrichtung" and Langtext "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" are vague regarding the extent of site preparation (e.g., fencing, access roads, storage areas).
findings.suggestion: Detail the required site facilities, e.g., "Einrichtung von Sicherheitsabgrenzungen, Zugangspfade, Lagerflächen, und Baustellenbeleuchtung."

findings.title: Missing connection details for PE-HD pipe
findings.message: The description does not specify the type of connection fittings, jointing method, or pressure class, which are necessary for compliance with DIN 1936 and VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "PE-HD Rohr DN 150, Druckklasse 16, einschließlich Verbindungsteilen (Kopplungen, Übergangskappen) nach DIN 1936."

findings.title: Missing concrete class and reinforcement details for shaft
findings.message: The Schacht DN 1000 position lacks specification of concrete class, reinforcement, and curing conditions required for VOB/C compliance.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen, C25/30, mit Stahlbewehrung Ø 12 mm, 3 cm Abstand, nach DIN 1045."

findings.title: Missing details for cement screed
findings.message: The description does not state the required thickness, reinforcement, or curing regime for the Zementestrich CT-C25-F4.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Zementestrich CT-C25-F4, d = 50 mm, mit Stahlbewehrung Ø 8 mm, 3 cm Abstand, nach DIN 1045."

findings.title: Missing paving details
findings.message: The Pflasterdecke position lacks specification of paving material, joint width, and compaction method.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Betonpflaster, 20×20 cm, 2 cm Joints, nach DIN 18331, Verdichtung mit Vibrationsplatte."

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer specifications
findings.message: The Asphalttragschicht position does not specify layer thickness, aggregate type, or compaction parameters required by VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Asphalttragschicht, 10 cm, Aggregat 0–20 mm, Verdichtung 3 Durchgänge, nach DIN 18331."

findings.title: Missing asphalt deck specifications
findings.message: The Asphaltdeckschicht position lacks details on layer thickness, aggregate, and compaction, which are mandatory for VOB/C compliance.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Asphaltdeckschicht, 5 cm, Aggregat 0–10 mm, Verdichtung 2 Durchgänge, nach DIN 18331."
